name: manual_7d306a
claim: Reasoning-effort support is verified live, never assumed: ask for medium, else high, else low (never xhigh or max) and always send the level explicitly. The checked-in template value (the last live-verified level) applies on every provider switch; the medium-high-low walk is only a periodic, reviewed re-check during repository updates, not a per-switch billed cost.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-12 live probes: W&B DeepSeek V4.1 models rejected medium with HTTP 400 and accepted high; BigModel GLM-5.3-Flash defaults to max when effort is omitted and rejects medium. Per-switch billed probes are not acceptable cost, so the walk runs opt-in during reviewed updates with a live model list, effort probes and one tool task in a throwaway Cline config directory. Balance, auth or rate-limit errors mean could not verify, never rejected.
